rationale: The fade thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still below VWAP (33.75) and the session open with the original 33.80 invalidation untouched, while the bounce off the 33.35 low is occurring on steadily shrinking volume (21k→9k), consistent with a corrective drift rather than a reversal. Risk to the stop is roughly $62 against ~$93 to the 33.15 target on a position that is already small, so holding beats closing into a mid-range chop, though the test of the 9-EMA at 33.55 and the improving tape (SPY and VIXY both less risk-off than at entry) mean the edge has thinned. A flip to long is not justified — it would mean buying beneath VWAP resistance into a day that still prints lower highs and lower lows, with no new catalyst to support it.
